key_impacts: Storm-surge flooding exceeded New York City’s 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
About 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
Two New Jersey refineries (Hess Port Reading; Phillips 66 Bayway in Linden) shut down, cutting 26.3% of 1,170,200 BPD operating capacity.
Gas stations in New Jersey could not operate due to power outages.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to the outage.
evidence_snippets: On October 29, Sandy’s arrival coincided with high tide, producing a massive surge.
Flooding exceeded the 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide in New York City.
